terrain_fields.title: Water coverage
terrain_fields.meaning: Fraction of the decoded terrain occupied by water.
terrain_fields.caution: A learned request, not an exact percentage guarantee. Finishing preserves raw predicted SDF-sign area, not the requested percentage.

terrain_fields.title: Elevation range / relief
terrain_fields.caution: Relief is vertical amplitude, NOT local slope, cliff steepness or sharpness.

terrain_fields.title: Land connection between bases
terrain_fields.meaning: Whether the two planned bases belong to the same derived land component.
terrain_fields.caution: Training support must be checked; asking for an unseen setting is extrapolation.

terrain_fields.title: Total front width
terrain_fields.meaning: Median sum of cross-section widths in the central distance-phase band.
terrain_fields.caution: Terrain-only geometry. Not the earlier resource-attracted economic front_width score.

terrain_fields.title: Largest front opening
terrain_fields.meaning: Median largest connected span across the same central band.
terrain_fields.caution: A geometric span is not necessarily an independent strategic route.

terrain_fields.title: Persistent front fragmentation
terrain_fields.meaning: Fraction of sampled interior length with sustained multiple effective spans.
terrain_fields.caution: Related to split openings, but NOT an integer passage count or guaranteed number of attack lanes.

terrain_fields.title: Sustained bottleneck width
terrain_fields.meaning: Minimum sustained, window-averaged total cross-section width.
terrain_fields.caution: A width constraint learned statistically, not an explicit route-construction algorithm.

terrain_fields.title: Largest bottleneck opening
terrain_fields.meaning: Minimum sustained, window-averaged largest individual span.
terrain_fields.caution: Does not certify independent paths or unit-size clearance.

terrain_fields.title: Bottleneck severity / pinch
terrain_fields.meaning: One minus sustained bottleneck total width divided by typical front total width.
terrain_fields.caution: Higher means stronger relative contraction; must be consistent with the width requests.

terrain_fields.title: Length of the narrow section
terrain_fields.meaning: Longest run below the configured low-width threshold.
terrain_fields.caution: A terrain measurement, not travel time or a requested number of choke points.

runtime.name: Planned base coordinates
runtime.effect: Rasterizes the two spatial conditioning channels.
runtime.limit: Starts are supplied before geometry, not generated by this network.

runtime.name: Seed
runtime.effect: Changes initial Gaussian noise and therefore the sampled layout.
runtime.limit: A fixed seed alone is not a cross-machine reproducibility guarantee.

runtime.name: Guidance strength (CFG)
runtime.effect: Changes how strongly conditional predictions differ from the null-control prediction.
runtime.limit: Stronger is not necessarily more correct; it can introduce artifacts. Probe default is 1.5.

runtime.name: Sampling steps
runtime.effect: Changes the number of iterative denoising updates; probe default is 100.
runtime.limit: Not a training epoch count, and not a specific terrain-shape request.

runtime.name: Symmetry mode / projection
runtime.effect: Enforces a chosen symmetry on full-map fields or native geometry.
runtime.limit: Current example uses 180-degree rotation. This is not learned symmetry conditioning.

runtime.name: Smoothing preset
runtime.effect: none / light / medium selects native-grid smoothing sigma 0 / 2 / 4 with coast protection.
runtime.limit: A deterministic height edit, not a trained sharpness parameter; default finishing is light.

runtime.name: Mex count / hydro count / water enabled
runtime.effect: Profile changes generated heatmaps; counts also cap the decoder.
runtime.limit: Example export uses 32 mexes and 2 hydros. Counts are not density ratings from the scientific scoring pipeline.

runtime.name: Resource seed / steps / guidance
runtime.effect: Changes marker heatmap sampling without retraining terrain.
runtime.limit: Keep base locations and native geometry consistent with the condition packet.

runtime.name: Peak threshold / spacing / symmetry
runtime.effect: Changes which heatmap maxima become actual marker pairs.
runtime.limit: Can reduce the output count. No terrain snapping or resource-pad repair is applied in the current raw export.

runtime.name: Tree energy / natural-rock mass budgets
runtime.effect: Scales physical target values while retaining the neural allocation fields.
runtime.limit: Tree mass is additional to rock mass and is included in total reclaim accounting.

runtime.name: Composer seed / asset pool
runtime.effect: Changes concrete blueprint variants, within-field positions and yaw.
runtime.limit: Does not change the deterministic neural heatmaps.

runtime.name: Budget-area grid / spacing / entity cap
runtime.effect: Changes local value accounting, center-spacing rejection and safety limits.
runtime.limit: 8x8 budget areas and zero spacing in the approved example. Unmet budgets remain local.

runtime.name: Wreck-mass budget / unit pool / seed
runtime.effect: Turns a fixed wreck-allocation field into selected unit wrecks.
runtime.limit: No abundance scalar or seed is supplied to the deterministic wreck network.

runtime.name: Wreck spacing / area grid / safety cap
runtime.effect: Controls physical instance spacing and budget quantization.
runtime.limit: Current export uses 2x2 areas, 4-unit center spacing, and explicit land-equivalent values even underwater.
